lines: 第一回一梦产子
在浩瀚的南海之滨，云雾缭绕间，矗立着一座神山——普陀洛迦山。
山上瑶台琼阁，瑞气氤氲，仙草芬芳，宝树参天，千花竞艳，五色斑斓。
梅花鹿悠闲漫步其间，山中处处灵韵盎然，仙境非凡。
今日且不表山上的正主观世音菩萨，单说菩萨门下的两位弟子——木吒与小龙女，此二人情谊深厚，堪比芝兰之交。
几日前，王母娘娘广发仙帖，邀集天界众仙，共赏蟠桃盛会，观音菩萨受邀赴会，家中只留他们两个，主持大小事务。
且说这一日，二人碁枰对弈，木吒巧妙布局，借助边角厚势，吃掉小龙女的一片黑子。
木吒一边提子，一边调侃：“哎呀，龙妹妹，你可别说我屠龙你哦。”
“我这实在是，实在是……，压制不住啊。”
小龙女见一副他得意洋洋之色，又好气又好笑，翻个白眼道：“吃进去，你还得给我吐出来。”
木吒闻听开玩笑道：“呵呵，吃了，就吐不出来了。”
“我可不像你们女生，吃到肚子里，还能生。”
此言一出，小龙女被羞涩的满脸通红，她羞恼之下，拍下手中的棋子，嗔怒道：“不下了，不输下流！”
木吒知道自己失言，想再收回来已难，他怕小龙女再去菩萨那儿告他的状，于是连忙过去，变着法的哄小龙女开心，可小龙女左右就是不听。
木吒左思右想就憋出一个法子，他亲自下厨熬了一碗银耳莲子羹，然后端到小龙女面前，一脸赔笑道：“龙妹妹，别生气了，尝尝这碗银耳莲子羹吧？”
“为了熬它，我消耗了自己五年的灵修，先用真火，后用大火，再改小火，最后用玄冰镇。”
小龙女闻听，噗呲一下没憋住，不禁笑出声来。
木吒见小龙女失声笑，知道自己设计成功，于是趁热打铁道：“龙妹妹，你尝尝，我保你喝了消气解渴。”
“别再怨恨我了，我知道自己错了。”
小龙女见木吒极力讨自己欢心，又见他熬的这碗羹，汤色莹透，莲子圆润，闻着就有一股淡淡的甜香，不觉心中喜欢，气已消了大半。
于是，便接过那碗羹，轻啜一口，眉目间闪过一丝笑。
木吒见状，乘势温言道：“这碗羹，采天地之灵气，汇日月之精华，既能消暑去火，还能养颜驻容，龙妹妹是真真有好福气呢。”
小龙女闻言，不禁又是噗嗤一笑，她嗔笑道：“木哥哥，你何时学得这般会说话了？
见小龙女笑颜如花，重新开心起来，木吒心中那块悬着着的石头终于落地，于是，两个人又一起说了些话，然后各自回房歇下。
且说小龙女正睡间，忽觉脸颊掠过一抹淡淡的凉意，恍若有细雨拂过窗棂，又似不经意间溅落到她脸上，小龙女睁开眼，抬手拂去脸上的水珠，眉黛微蹙，口中喃喃道：“这水哪儿来的？”
正疑惑间，忽听身后一个熟悉的人问话：“徒儿，你方才那一觉，睡得可好啊？”
小龙女闻听难以置信，她蓦地转身，眼光一亮：“菩萨，您……您怎的这般突然回来了？”
“不是说蟠桃赏会要一月方休吗？”
观音收起笑容，语气中带着一丝不易察觉的冷意，缓缓道：“怎么，你不愿意为师回来？”
“是不是我回来，搅了你的什么好事？”
小龙女听得心中一愣，心中暗自思量：“师父平素宽宏大量，温善慈爱，怎么今天说起话来，貌似话中有话，意有所指呢？”
正心生合计间，就见菩萨一指桌上的圣水瓶，语调柔和却带着不容置疑的口吻问：“我离开期间，你可曾谨遵我的嘱咐，收集圣水？”
观音瓶中盛装的，乃是灵山之巅的杨枝甘露，无根之水。
何为无根之水？说来奇妙，乃是每日拂晓，小龙女沐浴晨光，口诵心经，达到六根清净之后，方以圣水瓶轻轻承接，那来自柳枝之上，天地一夜之间孕育的甘露。
这个过程，小龙女是每日照做，没有半点含糊的。
小龙女迅速在脑海中过虑一遍，回答道：“徒儿谨遵师命，不敢有误。”
“大胆！”
观音菩萨闻听，却突然用手一拍桌子，这个情势冷不丁把小龙女吓得一哆嗦，她自幼跟随菩萨，还从未见菩萨如此动容过。
“师父一向宽宏大量，相若有光，今天这是怎么啦？”
就听观音接着说：“你还敢说一直谨遵我的吩咐。”
content_en:
The first time I gave birth in a dream
On the coast of the vast South China Sea, amid the clouds and mist, stands a sacred mountain - Mount Putuo Luojia.
The Qiongge of Yaotai on the mountain is filled with auspicious air, fragrant fairy grass, towering treasure trees, thousands of flowers, and colorful.
Sika deer stroll leisurely among them, the mountains are full of aura, and the wonderland is extraordinary.
Today we are not talking about the righteous Lord Shiyin Bodhisattva on the mountain, but are talking about the two disciples of the Bodhisattva - Mu Zha and Xiao Longnu. The friendship between these two people is as deep as Zhilan's acquaintance.
A few days ago, the Queen Mother sent out fairy invitations to invite all the immortals in the heaven to enjoy the peach feast. Guanyin Bodhisattva was invited to the meeting, leaving only the two of them at home to preside over all matters.
Let's talk about this day, when the two Qi Ping played chess, Muzha cleverly planned and took advantage of the advantage of the corner to eat a piece of Xiao Longnu's sunspot.
Mu Zha teased you while raising the zither: "Oh, Sister Long, don't say that I killed the dragon."
"I really, really...can't suppress it."
Seeing his triumphant expression, Xiao Longnu was angry and amused. She rolled her eyes and said, "If you eat it, you have to spit it out for me."
Mu Zha heard this and joked: "Haha, if you eat it, you won't be able to spit it out."
"I'm not like you girls who can still give birth after eating it."
As soon as these words came out, Xiao Longnu's face turned red with embarrassment. In embarrassment, she patted down the chess piece in her hand and said angrily: "No more, no less!"
Mu Zha knew that he had made a mistake, and it was difficult to take it back. He was afraid that the little dragon girl would go to the Bodhisattva to complain about him again, so he hurried over and tried various tricks to make the little dragon girl happy, but the little dragon girl wouldn't listen.
Mu Zha thought about it and came up with an idea. He personally cooked a bowl of Tremella fungus and lotus seed soup, then brought it to Xiao Longnu and said with an apologetic smile: "Sister Long, don't be angry. Can you try this bowl of Tremella lotus seed soup?"
"In order to survive it, I spent five years of my spiritual practice, first using real fire, then large fire, then small fire, and finally using black ice to suppress it."
When Xiao Longnu heard this, she couldn't hold it back and burst into laughter.
Seeing Xiao Longnu bursting into laughter, Muzha knew that his design was successful, so he struck while the iron was hot: "Sister Long, you have a try, and I'll make sure you drink it to relieve your qi and quench your thirst."
"Stop hating me. I know I was wrong."
When Xiao Longnu saw Mu Zha trying his best to please her, and seeing the bowl of soup he cooked, the soup was translucent in color, the lotus seeds were round, and there was a faint sweet fragrance when she smelled it. She felt like it and most of her anger was gone.
So, he took the bowl of soup, took a sip, and a smile flashed between his brows.
Seeing this, Mu Zha took advantage of the situation and said warmly: "This bowl of soup collects the aura of heaven and earth, and collects the essence of the sun and moon. It can not only relieve the heat and eliminate fire, but also nourish and maintain the beauty. Sister Long is really blessed."
Hearing this, Xiao Longnu couldn't help but laugh again, she said with a smile: "Brother Mu, when did you learn to speak so well?
Seeing Xiao Longnu smiling like a flower and becoming happy again, the hanging stone in Mu Zha's heart finally fell to the ground. So, the two of them talked some more together and then went back to their rooms to rest.
Let's say that Xiao Longnu was sleeping when she suddenly felt a faint coolness pass over her cheeks, as if drizzle was blowing across the window lattice, or splashing on her face inadvertently. Xiao Longnu opened her eyes, raised her hand to brush away the water droplets on her face, frowned slightly, and murmured: "Where did this water come from? "
While I was wondering, I suddenly heard a familiar person behind me ask: "Disciple, how did you sleep that night? "
Xiao Longnu couldn't believe what she heard. She suddenly turned around and her eyes lit up: "Bodhisattva, you... why did you come back so suddenly? "
"Didn't it say that the Peach Appreciation Fair will be closed for a month? "
Guanyin put away her smile, with an imperceptible coldness in her tone, and said slowly: "Why, you don't want to come back as a teacher? "
"Did I come back and disturb some of your good things? "
Xiao Longnu was stunned when she heard this, and thought to herself: "Master is usually magnanimous, gentle and kind, so why does he seem to have something in his words today? "
While he was thinking about it, he saw the Bodhisattva pointing at the bottle of holy water on the table, and asked in a gentle but unquestionable tone: "During my absence, did you follow my instructions and collect holy water? "
What is contained in the Guanyin bottle is the nectar of poplar branches at the top of Lingshan Mountain, water without roots.
What is rootless water? It is strange to say that at dawn every day, the little dragon girl bathes in the morning light and recites the Heart Sutra. After the six roots are purified, she gently uses the holy water bottle to receive the nectar that comes from the willow branches and is nurtured by heaven and earth overnight.
Xiao Longnu followed this process every day without any ambiguity.
Xiao Longnu quickly thought it over in her mind and replied: "Disciple, I will obey my master's orders and I don't dare to make any mistakes. "
"Bold! "
When Guanyin Bodhisattva heard this, he suddenly slapped the table with his hand. This sudden situation frightened Xiao Longnu. She had followed the Bodhisattva since she was a child and had never seen the Bodhisattva so moved.
"Master has always been magnanimous and bright, what happened today? "
Just listen to Guanyin continue to say: "You still dare to say that you have always followed my instructions. "
